venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Wednesday 3/25.** Busy especially early; conferences nearby increased alley foot traffic; many reservations and walk-ins before 9pm and at one point Marquee fully sat; gradually slowed with a small push in the last hour. Kitchen: busy, over 19% of sales; one missed bikini sandwich removed from the check with a table touch. MOD: Kevin / Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Wednesday 3/25.** Busy Wednesday: smooth beginning, packed middle turns, and a very chill but not-empty close. Pleasure to meet Rob Sulkin and Kyler's friend Spencer from High West; Happy Birthday Courtney. Comps $145.58. Top sellers: Wax Simulacra/Jabalina (tie), Year of the Trees, Grand Entrance. Kitchen: none. No door notes. (Report posted ~11:30am the next day.)
